question: across the WHOLE panel, does the fragment path execute transitions its proposal law never ranked?
verdict: PROPOSAL_IS_IN_SUPPORT ACROSS THE PANEL -- every apparent zero lifted with a larger draw budget

superstructure_generation.note: declares no interface, so the controller never redirects; no exposure by construction, not by measurement of recovery

scaffold_decoration.note: redirects most, so it is the worst case

the_finding_that_nearly_went_wrong: LOVASTATIN motif read 0.0000 at 256 AND at 2048 draws -- an eightfold increase with no recovery, which is a persuasive imitation of the T4 hard zero. It lifts to 0.80 at 8192. A zero that survives one budget increase is still not a hard zero; T4s survives ANY budget because the gated molecule is outside the support entirely.
consequence: No hard zero exists anywhere on the fragment panel. The attachment controller re-ranks inside the proposal law everywhere it acts, and a path program may be scored on this path. The asterisk on the earlier worst-case-only claim is closed.
limits: Every recovered_fraction is a LOWER BOUND at its draw budget; none of these establish that an unrecovered transition is absent, only that it is rarer than the budget resolves.
Redirect counts are small per drug (5 to 25), so a per-drug fraction is noisy; the panel claim rests on the DIRECTION of every curve, not on any single value.
